system.name: TANGO
system.one_liner: a hybrid control- and data-plane system that lets cooperating edge networks reroute traffic over the public Internet using trustworthy, fine-grained telemetry

content.subject: the life cycle of one packet through TANGO's monitor, reroute, and control-plane modules from sender to receiver

elements.name: BGP Pathfinder
elements.role: control-plane input feeding candidate paths into Route Updater

elements.name: Sender's Objectives
elements.role: sender-side per-class performance objectives feeding Route Updater

elements.name: Precomputed Signatures
elements.role: sender-side precomputed signatures feeding the Signer

elements.name: Precomputed OTPs
elements.role: sender-side precomputed one-time-pads feeding the Decryptor

elements.name: Precomputed OTPs
elements.role: receiver-side precomputed one-time-pads feeding the Encryptor

elements.name: Precomputed Signatures
elements.role: receiver-side precomputed signatures feeding the Verifier

elements.name: Sender's Objectives
elements.role: objectives shared with the receiver, feeding its Route Optimizer

elements.name: Path Mapper
elements.role: step 0: classifies incoming traffic into a path class by application (Web, Zoom, Games)

elements.name: Metrics Engine
elements.role: step 1: records the packet's path, sequence number, and timestamp

elements.name: Signer
elements.role: step 2: signs the recorded path/sequence/timestamp metrics

elements.name: Tunneled Packet
elements.role: the signed packet in transit toward the receiver

elements.name: Path Verifier
elements.role: step 3: checks the packet arrived via the correct path

elements.name: Verifier
elements.role: step 4: verifies the signature on the reported metrics

elements.name: Monitor
elements.role: step 5: calculates loss and delay from verified metrics before forwarding traffic onward

elements.name: Route Optimizer
elements.role: step 6: recomputes the route mapping from the receiver's objectives and signatures

elements.name: Encryptor
elements.role: step 7: OTP-encrypts a route-update packet if an update is needed

elements.name: Route Update Packet
elements.role: the encrypted route-update message in transit back to the sender

elements.name: Decryptor
elements.role: step 8: decrypts and verifies the OTP on the route-update packet

elements.name: Route Updater
elements.role: step 9: updates the sender's route tables using BGP Pathfinder and the sender's objectives

elements.name: Public Internet
elements.role: shared cloud that both the Tunneled Packet and the Route Update Packet dotted-line through

elements.name: Metadata
elements.role: vertical label marking the boundary carrying metadata between the Reroute and Monitor rows

content.key_idea: One packet's metrics and, when needed, one signed route update both travel the same round trip across the public Internet, verified at every hop before any route table is trusted enough to change.
content.reading_order: Monitor row left to right (0 through 5) along the bottom, then Reroute row right to left (6 through 9) above it, with Control Plane inputs feeding down into both rows

summary: This figure walks through the life cycle of one packet through TANGO's hybrid control- and data-plane pipeline, from a TANGO sender (left) to a receiver (right), across ten numbered steps. In the Monitor row, traffic is classified by application into a path class (0, Path Mapper), its path and timing are recorded (1, Metrics Engine) and signed (2, Signer), tunneled across the Public Internet, then checked for the correct path (3) and a valid signature (4) before Monitor (5) computes loss and delay. In the Reroute row, the receiver's Route Optimizer (6) recomputes the mapping, an Encryptor (7) OTP-protects a route-update packet sent back across the Public Internet, a Decryptor (8) verifies it, and Route Updater (9) applies BGP-guided changes to the sender's route tables. A Control Plane band above supplies each step's precomputed signatures, OTPs, and objectives.
summary_zh: 该图走读TANGO包的生命周期：Monitor行按应用分Path、记录签名(0-2)，经公网校验路径签名(3-4)，算丢包延迟(5)；Reroute行优化路由(6)，OTP加密更新包经公网解密验证(7-8)，据BGP更新路由表(9)。
notes: base set to 'component' since 'architecture' is not a valid base value for mechanism records; the figure is a numbered walkthrough over many named component boxes. The given paragraph is a short framing sentence, so most step-level meanings (the bold action labels and icons on each box, e.g. 'Check Correct Path', 'Optimize Route Mapping') are read from the figure itself rather than quoted text. No source-SVG colour histogram exists for this figure, so palette hex values come from the index's measured-attributes summary (its top 5 of 11 total colours); a green hue mentioned in that summary could not be matched to an exact hex and is noted qualitatively instead. Repeated control-plane labels ('Sender's Objectives', 'Precomputed OTPs', 'Precomputed Signatures') are kept as literal duplicates, disambiguated by container (left/right).
